values.scope: Five fixed-rate checkpoint-controlled repetitions; Java agent on; no capacity or cost-per-workflow claim

values.interpretation: Java25 observed p95 was 0.861882 ms lower at the median paired difference; four pairs were lower and one higher. Both runtimes achieved 10 timely correct outcomes/s. Small exploratory fixed-workload difference, not equivalence, capacity or a broad runtime performance win.
The observed paired p95 differences are small and change sign across five pairs at a fixed 10/s. This study establishes no meaningful speedup, capacity gain, or statistical equivalence.

interpretation: Request windows use arrival cohorts; late completions stay with their original arrivals.
Resource windows use observation time; controller snapshots are deduplicated by role and timestamp.
Counter endpoint deltas are descriptive. Decreases are retained and make the delta unknown.
Database growth includes retained workflow history; it is not automatically a leak.
One observation cannot establish leak-free operation, saturation or production sizing.
No new acceptance threshold is introduced by this review.

values.status: 16/s confirmation closed: 3 measured passes, observation 4 aborted in warmup, observation 5 unattempted. 16/s is not qualified. Eight-hour 10/s soak remains accepted.
values.claim: The 16/s confirmation is incomplete. It does not qualify 16/s or establish maximum capacity.
